references.text: John the Baptist speaks about baptizing with water, but mentions that another will baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire, which points directly to what Jesus says in Mark.
John the Baptist repeats the message that he baptizes with water, but one stronger than him will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
The Acts of the Apostles refers to John's baptism with water and Jesus' promise of baptism with the Holy Spirit.
Peter remembers Jesus' words that John baptized with water, but they would be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
